description: Repair a bug and extend a function while preserving existing behavior.

signature: type Order = { id: string; status: 'paid' | 'pending' | 'refunded'; amountCents: number }; function summarizeOrders(orders: readonly Order[]): { paidCount: number; netCents: number; paidIds: string[] }
